Commentary.Commentary: 137 is the target now! The Pakistan batters will fancy their chances, anything other than a win for them will surely be a surprise. Bangladesh on the other hand, need to bowl really well, wickets is what they need or they would find it really difficult to get back in this game. Stay tuned for the chase.

For Bangladesh, only Tamim showed some fight. He managed a half ton but received minimal support from the other end. Also, the visitors' batters never got the timing right on this wicket. They struggled to score freely and in the end, have posted a score well-below par.

Another excellent bowling display from the hosts! Right from the word go they were brilliant. The home side did not concede a lot in the Powerplay and they also managed to take a couple of wickets. During the middle overs, Shadab Khan and Shoaib Malik did exceedingly well and towards the end, Rauf and Afridi ended things brilliantly. However, it was Hasnain who was the pick as he went for just the 20 in his four and also took a couple of wickets.

FOUR! Good way to finish  the innings. Rauf goes full outside off and Islam makes room to slash it through cover-point. There is no one manning that region and the ball races to the fence in a flash. BANGLADESH FINISH ON 136/6!
Short ball outside off, Sarkar looks to play the scoop but cannot get anything behind the shot the ball hits his pads and rolls towards third man. the batsmen get a leg bye.
Full ball on the pads, Islam misses his flick to get hit on the pads. The bowler appeals only to sees a stoned faced umpire. The batsmen cross ends. A leg bye is what the get.
Slower one outside off, Islam looks to lay wood on the ball but is beaten on the outside edge there.
FOUR! Full ball once again. Islam throws the bat at it only to get an inside edge past the stumps. The ball races to the fence at fine leg in no time.
Aminul Islam is the new man in.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! What a sight to see for any fast bowler. Mahmudullah looks to go big but is nowhere in a position to play the pull. The ball keeps a bit low too and it shatters the stumps behind. The skipper is gone for not much to his name.
Another full ball flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Slower full ball on leg, Mahmudullah looks to flick it but the ball goes past the inside edge and between his legs. It also goes past the leg pole and keeper does the rest.
Sarkar plays the inside out shot on this length ball but gets only a single.
Full and outside off, squeezed through covers for a run.
A yorker this time, not a lot you can do about that. Sarkar guides it towards point for one.
A low full toss on the pads, Sarkar works it through mid-wicket and takes two.
WIDE! Bowls a yorker but down the leg side. Wided.
Full on off, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball outside off, pulled towards mid-wicket for single.
Soumya Sarkar walks out to bat!

OUT! RUN OUT! A wicket from nowhere for Pakistan. Wasim is the man who has done it. Rauf goes full and outside off, Tamim drives it towards covers and calls for  run. Wasim there collects the ball and takes the aim towards the stumps at the bowler's end. Imad has only stump to aim at and he scores a direct hit. As soon as Wasim hit the Pakistan players were rejoicing. The umpire though takes it upstairs and the replays confirm that Iqbal was short of of his crease there when the ball hit the stumps. A wicket here robs Bangladesh of all the momentum here.
RUN OUT APPEAL taken upstairs.
Iqbal pushes this length ball outside off towards covers.
WIDE! Length ball down the leg side. Rizwan there fails to collect it.
Slower ball outside off, Mahamudullah looks to pull it but is foxed by the pace there. The ball goes past the outside edge of the bat and into the gloves of the keeper.
FOUR! Attempted yorker goes wrong. He dishes a full ball on the pads and Mahmudullah flicks it towards fine leg and the ball races to the fence there.

FOUR! What happened there. The fielder spills the ball at it races to the fence at third man. Iqbal squeezes this full ball outside off towards short third man where Rauf is stationed the ball bursts through his hands and meets the fence.
A yorker on middle, Mahmudullah flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full toss on middle, Tamim drags it towards long on for a run.
Length ball outside off, Mahmudullah drives it through covers and gets to the other end.
Full on off, Tamim drives it past the bowler and towards long off fence for a run.
Full on the pads, flicked away towards fine leg for a single.
Full once again, Mahmudullah sweeps it through square leg and keeps the strike.
Full and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Back to back boundaries for Tamim. Short ball outside off, Iqbal pulls it into the gap at mid-wicket and finds the fence once again.
FOUR! Low full toss and Iqbal throws his bat at it. The ball goes past the short third man fielder and into the fence behind for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Tamim goes for a wild swing only to miss the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Fifty for Tamim! He brings it up in style! Needs to keep going and take his team to a competitive total here. It is short and outside off, Tamim cuts and it goes through covers for a boundary.
Slower short ball on middle, Iqbal goes for the pull only to get a top edge as the ball lobs towards covers. The batsmen take a single.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket and the skipper gets off the mark here.
Mahmudullah walks in to bat now. Can the skipper lead his team to a competitive total here?

OUT! CAUGHT! Afif departs in search of quick runs. Short ball outside off, Afif makes room and flashes it hard but fails to middle it. The ball takes the outside edge and goes high towards third man where Rauf takes it with ease.
Slower ball outside off, Hossain fails once again to lay bat on ball on his slower one and the keeper does well to collect it.
WIDE! The slower one goes wrong here. He goes down the leg side and the batsman fails to lay bat on ball. A wide called in the end by the umpire.
Length ball outside off, lofted down the ground towards long on for a run.

NOT OUT! It is pitching outside leg! That is why Tamim was furious and signaled the 'T' with an angry look on his face. He is still shaking his head as he walks back to the striker's end. He shuffles across and Hasnain bowls it around leg and then it angles away. Tamim looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. A huge shout, the umpire is unmoved. Tamim goes for a run, the bowler picks the ball up and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. All off a sudden the umpire has his finger raised. Tamim reviews and replays show that the on-field call has to be overturned. Tamim survives to fight another day.
What just happened there? A huge appeal for an LBW, the umpire remained unmoved for a long time. Tamim ended up completing a run and then the finger goes up. Tamim reviews, looks close though.

NOT OUT! Hossain was running to the danger end there. But he is safe there. Good running between the wicket there from these two. Iqbal pushes this length ball outside off towards mid off and calls for a quick run. The fielder there goes for a direct hit at the striker's end and scores a bulls eye. The umpire take it upstairs. The replays roll in and finds Afif to be safe when the bails go up. A run in the end.
RUN -OUT appeal sent upstairs.
Full ball outside off, driven towards mid off and the batsmen take a quick run.
Back of a length on off, pushed to the off side for a run.
Good yorker there. Iqbal does well to keep it out.
Now, Afif pushes this full ball through covers for a quick single.
Full and on off, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball on the last ball too. Hossain goes for the pull but misses to get any thing behind that shot. The keeper collects it.
Once again short ball and pulled away to mid-wicket by Iqbal for a run.
Another short ball pulled to mid-wicket for a run.
FREE HIT! But just a single. Short ball outside off, Tamim pulls it through mid-wicket and the ball goes on the bounce to the fielder there.

NO BALL! Oh what happened there. Hasnain bowls a high full toss. May be that slipped out of his hand there. Iqbal looks to lay bat on ball but he too misses. The umpire signals it as a no ball. Free Hit coming up.

An appeal for LBW but not given. Iqbal looks to drive this length ball outside off towards covers but he fails to get rapped on the pads. The bowler and his team appeals only get a negative result of it.
Back of a length and outside off, Hossain hops and taps it towards point for a single.
Mohammad Hasnain is back on!
Flatter and outside off, cut through point for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Iqbal punches it covers for a single.
SIX! Iqbal shows how to step down and loft this tossed up ball over the bowler's head and into the sight screen for a biggie.
Afif comes down the wicket and drives it through covers for a single.
Full and on middle, Iqbal drives it past the bowler who puts his foot there but the ball rolls past him towards long off. A run taken.
Tossed up on off, tucked towards mid-wicket and the batsmen take an easy couple.
Iftikhar Ahmed to bowl now.
One more single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, it is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Afif makes room again and he is followed by Malik. It is slapped to covers.
A very full ball outside off, it is jammed down towards third man for one.

Clever bowling! Hossain makes room and Malik slows it up. He lands it on middle, Afif looks to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge as the ball turns a touch. It goes towards the off side for one.
Shorter and around off, this is pushed down to long on for one.
A ripper outside off, Afif looks to run it down towards third man but the ball sneaks past the outside edge and goes into the mitts of the keeper. Rizwan there appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
SIX! Now comes the conventional sweep shot. Tossed up ball on middle, Hossain sweeps it through the line and the ball goes over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Hossain now read the legnth early and gets into the position early there. He reverse sweeps it past the keeper and into the third man fence for a boundary. That also  brings up the 50 for Bangladesh.
Short and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
NOT OUT! Good running there by the two batsmen.
Run Out appeal sent upstairs. It seems that Tamim is ok there.
Loopy outside off, cut towards short third man.
Shorter and on middle, Iqbal stays back and defends it onto the ground.
On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Another single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Shorter and outside off, it is slapped through covers for one.
Angled into the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Hossain  taps this full ball outside off towards point.

OUT! LBW! Bangladesh though retain the review. Umpire's call on hitting. Marginal there. Khan tosses one up on middle and the ball turns past the attempted pull of Das. The ball hits the pads and the bowler appeals. His team mates join in the appeal too. The umpire raises his finger but Das is taking his chances as he signals 'T'. The replays roll in and Shadab is fine in his stride. The Sniko comes in and confirms there is no bat involved. The Hawk-Eye later shows the ball to be pitching in line along with the impact in line. The ball is just clipping the outside part of the leg stump. That means its an umpire's call and Das has to take the long walk back.
Das has been given out LBW, he reviews it straightaway though. It could be a good one.
BEATEN! A straighter one from Shadab Khan there outside off, Das looks to cut it but once again he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full and on leg, tucked to square leg for a run.
Tossed up on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, driven to covers.
Shadab Khan is into the attack!
FOUR! That is left hander's elegance. Length ball outside off, Iqbal leans into the drive and crunches the drive through covers for a boundary.
Das drives this time straight towards mid off and hares for a quick single.
Once again Das gets beaten. He is struggling to time the ball here. He fails to lay wood on the ball on this length ball outside off.
BEATEN! Length and outside off, Das goes for the drive but is beaten on the outside edge.
Short ball outside off, Das drops his wrists and lets it go.
Full and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Length and on the pads, flicks to the leg side for a single.
Short ball on middle, pulled to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Punched with perfection. Rauf goes back of a length and outside off, Das punches it past the point fielder and the ball runs to the fence in a jiffy.
Three dots in a row! Another back of a length delivery and on off, it is pushed to mid off.
Length and around off, it is pushed towards cover for another dot.
Back of a length and on off, it is pushed to mid off.
Haris Rauf is into the attack now.
Iqbal cuts this length ball outside off towards point where the fielder dives to his right and saves a certain boundary.

DROPPED! These catches should be taken. Rizwan's reflexes are poor here. Iqbal looks to run this down towards third man but the ball takes the inside edge and flies past the stumps. The keeper is late to react to it as he dives to his right but the ball hits his gloves and goes to the ground. Pakistan need to be alert in the field.
FOUR! Hasnain errs in line by going on the pads. Iqbal flicks it past the short fine leg fielder and into the fence.
Back of a length ball on off, pushed through point for a single.
Liton Das walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! The move to send Mahedi Hasan up the order does not work. Hasnain bowls short and in to the body. Hasan goes for the pull but the ball hurries onto him and the ball catches the top edge and goes high up in the air towards the keeper where Rizwan takes the catch.
Length and wide outside off, Hasan throws the kitchen sink at it only to miss it.
Mohammad Hasnain to bowl now.
Good length and on middle, Hasan flicks to through mid-wicket and retains the strike.
Length and outside off, pushed to covers by Hasan.
Short once again, This time pulled to mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball on middle, Tamim pulls it all along the ground through mid-wicket and gets a comfortable two.
Another full ball on off, Tamim drives it to covers.
Full on off, Iqbal drives it back to the bowler.
A single to end an expensive one from Wasim. Flatter and outside off, it is guided towards point for one.
FOUR! Swept and swept nicely! on the pads, Tamim sweeps it behind square on the leg side and bags a boundary. This is a good over for Bangladesh.
A single now as it is worked through mid-wicket.

SIX! That is big! A much-needed one. First of the game. Hasan goes down on one knee and hits it with the angle. Nails it over the mid-wicket fence. Smart shot as Imad does not turn the ball a lot so it is a safe one.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Comes down the track but Imad shortens the length. Mehidi looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Hasan is once again late to play the shot. He just about manages to tuck it off the back foot towards fine leg and he gets off the mark with a single.
BEATEN! Beauty of a nut. Afridi lands on off the batsman once a again looks to play off the back foot the ball sneaks between the bat and pad and into the mitts of the keeper.
Good length and outside off, Hasan drives it to mid off.
Outside off, left  alone.
Mahedi Hasan to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Early blow for Bangladesh. Afridi strikes on the second ball of his first over. He bowls one in the channel outside off and shapes away a touch. Mohammad Naim is caught on the back foot there as the ball just catches the faint outside edge and lands safely into the mitts of the keeper.
Length and on off, Iqbal flicks it to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Shaheen Afridi to bowl from the other end.
A dot to end the over. Iqbal pushes it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, Tucked back to the bowler.
Floated on off, Iqbal tucks it to mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Flighted on middle, flicked to mid on.
WIDE! Wasim bowls one down the leg side. The umpire calls it a wide. Bangladesh are off the mark.
Once again a floater on middle, Tamim plays it to mid-wicket.
Starts with a tossed up ball on middle, Iqbal tucks it to mid-wicket.

We are all set to begin. The Pakistan players are out in the middle with their skipper have a few words before they disperse. Tamim Iqbal and Mohammad Naim are the two openers for Bangladesh. Imad Wasim will open the bowling for Pakistan.

Bangladesh  (Playing XI): Tamim Iqbal, Mohammad Naim, Liton Das (WK), Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Soumya Sarkar, Mahedi Hasan (IN FOR MOHAMMAD MITHUN), Aminul Islam, Shafiul Islam, Mustafizur Rahman, Al-Amin Hossain.
Pakistan (UNCHANGED PLAYING XI): Babar Azam (C), Ahsan Ali, Mohammad Hafeez, Shoaib Malik, Iftikhar Ahmed, Imad Wasim, Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Shadab Khan, Haris Rauf, Shaheen Afridi, Mohammad Hasnain.
TOSS - It's toss time in Lahore. Both the captain's are in the middle. Babar Azam will flip the coin. Mahmudullah calls and it lands in his favour. Bangladesh have won the toss and chose to bat.

With less than 24 hrs of time for turnaround Pakistan would not mind it after an easy win in the 1st T20I. Bangladesh, on the other hand, have a lot to ponder if they have to keep the series alive. They were poor with their batting as they could amass only 141 in their 20 overs. After a 71-run opening stand none of the Bangladeshi batsmen looked to play a stable innings. They would look to give a lot better  batting display today and give their bowlers something to play with. Pakistan would look to seal the series today itself and get on the path of revival in their favorite format. Toss and team updates in a while.
